column1: # The five ergon-io arms whose echo ran on the housekeeping CPU in
# aws-20261029-040029 and aws-20261029-055245. Same rates, streams and
# kernel-peer loss as transport-aws-io-bypass.tsv. UDP and io-tcp-fstack
# stay out: those pongs were already pinned.
arm io-tcp-epoll  wstls_lat  sockets two --impl ergon --backend epoll-spin --echo tcp
arm io-tcp-smol   wstls_lat  sockets two --impl ergon --backend smoltcp-spin --echo tcp
arm io-ws-epoll   wstls_lat  sockets two --impl ergon --backend epoll-spin --echo wstls
arm io-ws-smol    wstls_lat  sockets two --impl ergon --backend smoltcp-spin --echo wstls
arm io-ws-fstack  wstls_fstack_lat sockets two --impl ergon --backend fstack-spin --echo wstls
